propositions: Operators lack an on-demand, non-blocking way to verify that mapped Jira project keys and legacy_default in projects.json are currently visible to the bot outside a full reconcile pass

The bridge fsck command should add an optional --live-visibility flag that performs a live advisory check of mapped-project visibility by reusing the shared helper from ticket D (check_mapped_project_visibility)

When Jira credentials (JIRA_URL, JIRA_USER, JIRA_API_TOKEN) are absent or incomplete, the visibility check should gracefully skip with a skipped/missing_credentials advisory without calling the probe or altering the exit code

The visibility diagnostic must be read-only, produce advisory output to stderr in both text and JSON modes, and leave the stdout JSON schema (unknown_event_types, binding_drift, store_integrity) unchanged
The new live-visibility logic must not be added to core rebar doctor (which must remain Jira-free) and must not create a separate bridge doctor verb
A mapped project in projects.json that is syntactically valid but invisible to the bot (or nonexistent in Jira) should be immediately identifiable as missing or invisible in the diagnostic output
